question: Where can I find restaurant that falls within 20 kilometers in the direction of travel toward Brighton Asylum, Passaic, NJ?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983176 40.770074)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.143347 40.858032)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983176 40.770074)',4326)::geography, 20000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983176 40.770074)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

[3].display_name: New York Institute of Technology, New York, NY
